name: algo
description_en: Set up a personal VPN in the cloud
readme_excerpt: Algo VPN Algo VPN is a set of Ansible scripts that simplify the setup of a personal WireGuard and IPsec VPN. It uses the most secure defaults available and works with common cloud providers. See our release announcement for more information.
